mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen accessibility renovation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a kitchen accessibility renovation varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. Minor adjustments might take a few weeks, while comprehensive redesigns involving structural changes and custom cabinetry can extend to several months. As your single point of coordination, AKN Design Group provides a managed process with upfront estimates and scheduling transparency. We work diligently to minimize disruption and maintain clear communication throughout the project, ensuring a reliable timeline from design planning to final walkthrough.
